messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: Letters to joint policyholders only display one name, leading to confusion.
  quote: we’re getting complaints because our letters to joint policyholders only show one name — it’s causing confusion
- problem: The system fails to merge both joint policyholder names, displaying only one name.
  quote: We’re getting complaints because the system isn’t merging both names correctly — it’s only showing one joint policyholder names, and customers are understandably upset.
- problem: The system merges joint policyholder names incorrectly, often showing only one or the wrong name.
  quote: We’re getting complaints because when there are joint policyholder names, the system merges them incorrectly—sometimes only showing one or the wrong one, and it’s causing real issues with policyholders.
- problem: Joint policyholder names are not being merged correctly, leading to complaints.
  quote: Appreciate you taking this seriously — we’ve had three complaints this month just because the joint policyholder names weren’t merged correctly.
- problem: Letters to joint policyholders only display one name, causing complaints.
  quote: We’re seeing repeated issues where letters sent to joint policyholders only display one name — this leads to complaints and we need the joint policyholder names to appear correctly in all communications.
- problem: Letters generated for joint policyholder cases have mismatched names.
  quote: We’ve got a few joint policyholder cases where the letters are coming out with mismatched names—causing complaints.
- problem: When letters merge multiple names, only one name appears—often the wrong one—leading to client complaints and loss of trust.
  quote: The issue with letters merging multiple names on letters is causing us real problems — clients are complaining because only one name shows up, and sometimes it’s not even the right one.
- problem: The system mishandles joint policyholder names in outgoing letters.
  quote: we’ve been having some trouble with joint policyholder names in outgoing letters
